spec.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    country_name AS name,
    COUNT(*) AS old_installations,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, country_name) AS rn
  FROM phonehome_nethserver8_node_versions
  GROUP BY country_name
)
SELECT name, old_installations
FROM (
  SELECT name, old_installations, 1 AS grp, rn AS ord
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 5

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'Other countries', SUM(old_installations)::bigint, 2, 0
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn > 5
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
) t
ORDER BY grp, ord;

SELECT
  country_code AS code,
  country_name AS name,
  COUNT(*) as nsec_installations
FROM
  phonehome_installations
WHERE
  category = 'nethsecurity'
GROUP BY
  country_code,
  country_name;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    country_name AS name,
    COUNT(*) AS installation_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, country_name) AS rn
  FROM phonehome_installations
  WHERE category = 'nethsecurity'
  GROUP BY country_name
)
SELECT name, installation_count
FROM (
  SELECT name, installation_count, 1 AS grp, rn AS ord
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 5

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'Other countries', SUM(installation_count)::bigint, 2, 0
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn > 5
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
) t
ORDER BY grp, ord;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) as ns_installations
FROM
  phonehome_installations
WHERE
  category = 'nethserver8';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) as nsec_installations
FROM
  phonehome_installations
WHERE
  category = 'nethsecurity';

# PhoneHome service

The PhoneHome service provides a insight on how many NethServer/NethSecurity installations are live and working.
Additional info can be found below separated by product and version.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  day,
  active_count AS active_firewalls
FROM
  phonehome_daily_active_counts
WHERE
  category = 'nethsecurity'
ORDER BY
  day;

SELECT
  day,
  active_count AS active_clusters
FROM
  phonehome_daily_active_counts
WHERE
  category = 'nethserver8'
ORDER BY
  day;

SELECT
  day,
  active_count AS installation_count
FROM
  phonehome_daily_active_counts
WHERE
  category = 'nethserver67'
ORDER BY
  day;

SELECT
